steps.position: Put your left little finger (5) on {c3}, an octave below middle {c}, and your thumb (1) on {g}. These five notes go from the second space to the fourth space of the bass staff.
steps.readWithNames: Read this left-hand melody. The names are under the notes.
steps.readWithout: Now without names. Watch out for steps and skips.
steps.inTime: Now play it in time with the metronome.
